meta.name: tone-calibration
meta.description: Adjusting formality, warmth, confidence, and style per context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据场景调整语气风格，让文字更得体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同场合切换正式、温暖或自信的语气。
copy.tagline_en: Adjust tone for formality, warmth, and confidence per context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to adapt your writing style to different audiences and situations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据上下文自动调整语气，例如在教人时更温暖、纠正时更直接，涉及正式度、温暖度、自信度等维度。
howto.when: 当用户情绪变化、任务类型改变（如从创意到分析）、对话阶段转换或用户偏好不同时触发语气调整。

say.text: 用温柔鼓励的语气教我一道数学题
say.note: Claude 会降低正式度，提高温暖度。

say.text: 用正式权威的语气写一封商务邮件
say.note: Claude 会提高正式度和自信度。

say.text: 用轻松活泼的语气讲个笑话
say.note: Claude 会降低正式度，提高能量值。

howto.what_en: Claude adjusts tone (formality, warmth, confidence, etc.) per context, e.g., warmer when teaching, more direct when correcting.
howto.when_en: Triggered by user emotion, task type shift (e.g., creative to analytical), conversation stage change, or user preference.

say_en.text: Teach me math in a warm, encouraging tone.
say_en.note: Claude lowers formality and raises warmth.

say_en.text: Write a formal business email with authority.
Tell me a joke in a light, playful tone.
say_en.note: Claude lowers formality and raises energy.
